First point of contact with calling: School offices : Mrs Juggins / Mrs Wilson / Miss Dennis / Mrs Bastin Schools Business Manager: Mrs Cleland
On behalf of the staff, children, parents and governors we warmly welcome you to the schools websites that make us the Federation of Towers schools.
Our schools mission is that we BUILD our futures together! We may be two schools but we have one vision where all in our community strive for our core values of being; Respectful, United, Independent, Love of learning, Determined
As leaders of our schools we are passionate that our children get the best opportunities. As a staff, we believe in giving our children a curriculum that is engaging with enriching activities that foster a love of learning, not just for the here and now but for life.
When you enter our schools you can expect a caring and nurturing, exciting and stimulating learning environment where our children are at the centre of all we do. Where respect and unity are common qualities shared by all. Determination permeates every aspect of our school life and is a core value that everyone in our school community embraces - no one will be left behind! From the small acorns to mighty oaks, our children are encouraged, supported and challenged to be the best they can be; with opportunities presented to them throughout their learning journey to ignite their curiosity.
Governors are dedicated to promoting a caring, supportive, inclusive and vibrant learning environment and our parents want the best for their community. Our partnerships are key to the successes that our children display.
For further information about our two schools please click on the links. Alternatively if you would like to come and see us in 'action' please do make an appointment with our school offices where we would love to show you the fantastic learning journey that every child at Towers experiences!
Yours sincerely the Towers schools Senior Leadership Team

I am delighted to welcome you to Towers Infant School. I am extremely proud of our school, our team and most of all, our pupils.
We provide a happy, secure and caring environment where children can reach their full potential. Our children arrive at school enthusiastic, motivated and keen to learn. We encourage them to have enquiring minds, take pride in their achievements and to have a lifelong love of learning.
It is always a pleasure for to walk around our school and see happy, confident children who are eager to learn and whose excellent behaviour reflects their enthusiasm and love of learning.
We were inspected by Ofsted initially in March 2016 and we graded as an ‘outstanding’ school. Inspectors returned to our school in November 2021 and confirmed that we continue to be an outstanding school. However, we are never complacent and with the new Ofsted Framework [2025] there are no longer single word judgements therefore, we continue as we have done to ensure our children receive the very best education possible.
We greatly value our home-school links and aim to keep all parents and carers informed of what is happening within and around our school. I firmly believe that by working closely together we can ensure that your child is happy and will make great progress. We also work closely with our Junior school to ensure we build the maximum futures for our children. Demonstrating a love of learning, not just in the infant years but for life.
Head Teacher Infant School
